Marta (CSM): Heads-up: Acme stakeholder-bridge session in 3 days. Need slide leads, demo owner, onboarding snapshot, and a 1-slide renewal status. Keep replies short.
Priya (Onboarding): I27ll do onboarding snapshot: ingest 78%, eval pass 88%, blockers: Okta SSO cert + analytics RBAC.
Lenora (Solutions): I can run the demo: 5-min flow (ingest -> query -> rerank) + perf p50/p95. Need stable demo key and dataset pointer. @Evan confirm dataset name.
Jordan (Product): I27ll prepare two slides: roadmap highlights (30s) and a compact ROI slip showing monthly savings.
Evan (Acme): Dataset is catalog-2024Q2. Execs want emphasis on uptime and billing predictability. They27d like a 15-min pre-brief day-before.
Amir (CS Dir): Renewal flag: sponsor rotation last week. Recommend slide: sponsor map + mitigation asks (intro call, cost alignment, pilot extension).
Marta (CSM): Action list: Priya (onboard slide) due EOD tomorrow; Lenora (demo steps) due in 24h; Jordan (roadmap+ROI) due tomorrow noon; Amir (renewal slide) draft by EOD. Evan confirm pre-brief time.
Evan (Acme): Pre-brief yes  add 2024-06-25 16:00 UTC.
deploy-bot: Event created: Acme pre-brief  2024-06-25 16:00 UTC. Invites sent.
Priya (Onboarding): Okta metadata received but cert thumbprint changed. Escalating to eng-infra; ETA 4 hours. If fixed, I finish SSO mapping tonight.
Lenora (Solutions): Demo snippet for notes:
```
1) demo key: acme_demo_temp
2) ingest: s3://acme/catalog-2024Q2 -> ./sample
3) curl check: curl -H "Authorization: Bearer $KEY" https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate -d '{"prompt":"health check"}'
expect p95 < 250ms
```
Marta (CSM): Please paste your slide bullets into deck notes (link: https://docs.google.com/example). Rehearsal tomorrow 11:00 UTC. Short replies only.
Jordan (Product): Will add ROI assumptions and ranges.
Amir (CS Dir): I27ll draft the sponsor outreach lines.
Marta (CSM): Thanks everyone  I27ll post run-of-show after rehearsal. :thumbsup:
